lines.speaker: A
lines.say: BWE-nos DEE-as. kwal es el pro-BLE-ma?
lines.meaning: Good morning. What is the problem?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Tengo fiebre y dolor de cabeza desde ayer.
lines.say: TEN-go FYE-bre ee do-LOR de ka-BE-sa DES-de a-YER.
lines.meaning: I have a fever and a headache since yesterday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.meaning: Do you have a cough or a cold?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, solo la fiebre. Me siento débil.
lines.say: no, SO-lo la FYE-bre. me SYEN-to DE-beel.
lines.meaning: No, only the fever. I feel weak.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Tome esta medicina tres veces al día. Beba agua caliente.
lines.say: TO-me ES-ta me-dee-SEE-na tres BE-ses al DEE-a. BE-ba A-gwa ka-LYEN-te.
lines.meaning: Take this medicine three times a day. Drink warm water.

lines.speaker: B
lines.meaning: Thank you, doctor. When should I come again?
